proves.claim: pinFor(commit) returns {tree, tooling} and bundleFor(tree) writes a bundle keyed by tree id, reused when present.

pin.keyed.pin-and-bundle.why: A bundle keyed by tree id is what lets runs reuse the same source.

proves.claim: a bad tree id or unknown commit is refused with a code.

pin.keyed.refuses-bad-tree.why: Bad input must refuse with a code, not write a pin.

proves.claim: packages/pin writes the tooling pin for a landed commit, and toolingFor returns the last landing tree as tooling and the seat's own tree as source.

pin.tooling.landing-writes-pin.why: Runs must use the last landed tooling but the seat's own source.

proves.claim: a corrupt tooling pin is refused with a code and an unknown landing writes nothing.

pin.tooling.corrupt-pin-refused.why: A corrupt pin must never steer a run.

proves.claim: temp folders are caches named by tree id and a missing cache is rebuilt from the bundle.

pin.cache.rebuilt-from-bundle.why: A cache that cannot be rebuilt would be state, not a cache.

proves.claim: a sweep never breaks a queued job, it keeps named trees and the next read rebuilds the rest.

pin.cache.sweep-keeps-queued.why: A sweep must not break a job already queued.

proves.claim: an edited or unsigned tooling pin file is refused before any run uses it.

pin.signing.unsigned-refused.why: An unsigned pin could substitute tooling.

proves.claim: the first gate after an upgrade signs a pin file written before signing existed, once.

pin.signing.upgrade-signs-once.why: Upgrades must not strand older pin files.

proves.claim: a state-cache partial whose writer pid is dead is removed on the next write, and a live writer's partial stays.

pin.keyed.dead-partial-removed.why: Dead writers must not leave partials that block the next write.

proves.claim: every pin-cell test has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

pin.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: every pin test file that reads source files carries an input header naming the cells it reads, and none declares the whole tree

pin.inputs.declared.why: Affected-test selection can only see the inputs a test declares.
